conceptZh: 包：勹包住巳，把東西包起來。
object: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker with an oversized magnifying glass, and a pale steamed bun
morph: the pig proudly builds a silly wrong shape, spots it through the magnifying glass, shrugs and fixes it into 包
creativeAngle: 豬探長先拼出怪怪的形狀，放大鏡一照發現錯了，一秒修好成包。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean 2D/3D toy-animation clip. Teaching subject: the single Traditional Chinese glyph 包 (bun / bag), correctly formed, in a saturated solid color against a much lighter background, ending centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with margins. Lead cast: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker with an oversized magnifying glass, and a pale steamed bun. Light beige backdrop with a faint desk edge; the glyph is deep burgundy. Timed beats. 0.0-1.5s: a stout pig detective in a checked hat waddles in, hauling a magnifying glass bigger than himself; the voice says the first 包 as he flips open a mystery bundle and burgundy strokes tumble out. 1.5-3.0s: he proudly arranges them into a wobbly blob with a dot in the wrong spot and tips his hat. The voice says the second 包 as the magnifying glass swings up, his eye grows huge, and he spots the mistake. 3.0-4.5s: he shrugs, taps one stroke, and the whole shape slides into the proper 包 at 70% of frame height. 4.5-5.0s: the voice says 書包 (ㄕㄨ ㄅㄠ) as a little backpack plops beside him, its flap pops open, and he peeks in. Final hold: 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is still; the pig tips his hat as the magnifying glass sways at the edge. The glyph holds fully still and clearly readable for the last 3 seconds. Voice: one gentle off-screen voice in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, slow with crisp tones, reads precisely 包、包、書包 = ㄅㄠ、ㄅㄠ、ㄕㄨ ㄅㄠ, character, character, word, and nothing after it. Keep any background music quieter than the voice. The vocabulary word is audio only. The glyph 包 is the only text on screen: no subtitles, captions, labels, watermark, logos, clutter, flashing or strobing effects, and no real people or realistic human figures; all characters are stylized toys or cartoon animals.
